baseline: Your tests pass on the real BoundedStack

variants.name: pop-returns-oldest
variants.label: pop() returns the oldest item instead of the newest
variants.hint: Push two different values and check which one pop() gives back.

variants.name: top-returns-oldest
variants.label: top() returns the oldest item instead of the newest
variants.hint: Check top() after two pushes, and that it leaves the item in place.

variants.name: pop-keeps-size
variants.label: pop() does not shrink the stack
variants.hint: What are size() and top() after a pop?

variants.name: empty-inverted
variants.label: empty() gives the wrong answer
variants.hint: Check empty() on a new stack, after a push, and after a pop.

variants.name: push-full-drops-silently
variants.label: push() onto a full stack silently drops the item instead of throwing
variants.hint: The documentation promises an exception when the stack is full. Test that.

variants.name: pop-empty-returns-zero
variants.label: pop() on an empty stack returns 0 instead of throwing
variants.hint: What should happen when you pop an empty stack?

variants.name: top-empty-returns-zero
variants.label: top() on an empty stack returns 0 instead of throwing
variants.hint: top() has the same promise as pop() for an empty stack.

variants.name: clear-does-nothing
variants.label: clear() leaves the items in place
variants.hint: After clear(), is the stack really empty?

variants.name: zero-capacity-allowed
variants.label: a stack of capacity 0 is accepted
variants.hint: A capacity of 0 must be rejected with std::invalid_argument.
